description.value: Buzzy's Luncheonette is a beloved Jewish deli on Salt Spring Island, celebrated for house-made Montreal Smoked Meat — briskets cured for 8–10 days, smoked for 10 hours, and steamed to order. Founded in 2017 by a former LA standup comic and his wife, the tiny shop punches well above its weight and won the 2019 Salty Award for Best New Business and Best Menu Item. Cyclists crossing to Salt Spring will find hearty, distinctive sandwiches and house-made potato latkes ready for takeout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at buzzys.ca clearly identifies this as a Salt Spring Island business at 122-149 Fulford-Ganges Road, not Duncan as the OSM community field suggests — however, the OSM coordinates (48.8516°N, 123.4992°W) are consistent with Ganges on Salt Spring Island, so the node is correctly placed but the community metadata is wrong. The website confirms takeout service explicitly ('TAKE-OUT ORDERS', 'CALL TO ORDER'), and the menu includes clearly vegetarian items (latkes, grilled cheese on challah). No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Duncan' but the business is located on Salt Spring Island, BC; the OSM coordinates (48.8516°N, 123.4992°W) are consistent with Ganges, Salt Spring Island, so the node placement appears correct but the community metadata is incorrect.
OSM has no address or phone; both were sourced from the website and may need to be added to the OSM record.
Website footer copyright reads '©2021 BUZZYS.CA' which may indicate the site has not been recently updated, though summer hours announcement on the home page suggests active operation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating business on Salt Spring Island with an active website, confirmed phone number, and clear takeout service — a useful stop for cyclists on the island.
enrichment_extras.notes: The business is takeout/phone-order only — online ordering is explicitly unavailable. Smoked meat is also sold by the pound and frozen latkes are available in-store.
